Each line is true today and names the rows that built it. title: What Zenod does for you

groups.title: Talk to your memory
groups.intro: Ask, tell and call your memory from the web app.

features.title: Call your memory
features.text: Press the phone button in the chat and ask your memory out loud. It answers from your own notes and passes jobs to the memory desk. Nothing from a call is saved unless you keep it.

features.title: See where an answer came from
features.text: Press Show in graph under any chat answer. The memories it used light up in your memory graph with how well each matched, then the links between them turn green. Open any of them.

features.title: Ask Zenod who it is
features.text: Ask the chat who it is or what it can do and it tells you directly. Weak matches and private notes on family, health or money stay out of the memories it shows.

groups.title: Your plan
groups.intro: What your plan includes and where it goes.

features.title: See where your AI allowance goes
features.text: The Usage tab shows this month's spend on filing, answers, personas, desk jobs and calls, what each costs, and what happens when the allowance runs out. Your notes are always kept.

features.title: Apply to test Zenod
features.text: Tell us how you would use Zenod on the testers page. The first ten testers, picked by hand, get a free month of Zenod Hosted with no card, extended month by month.

groups.title: Your memory tree
groups.intro: How Zenod keeps your notes in order.

features.title: Your tree tidies itself
features.text: Each week, small pages on the same subject as a page beside them join it, word for word, and topics such as Markets get their own branch.

features.title: Check where Zenod filed things
features.text: Each new memory says how sure Zenod was of its place, and the least sure come first in the Memory tab. Say it is in the right place, or open any page on your tree, press Wrong place and pick where it belongs. Undo puts it back.
